text:
alice: Heads-up — aiming to cut the coordinated version pins + changelog for next Wed 10:00am PT. Need aligned bumps in api, runtime, console, python-sdk.

ben: Copy. What's the cutoff for last-minute breaking changes?

alice: Cutoff is Tue 18:00 PT. After that only critical fixes with PRs flagged `release/critical`.

carla: Quick Q: do SDKs get bumped in the sdk repo only, or do we also update console/package.json? I can do both if we have the final numbers.

devon: I'll take runtime. Plan: open PRs for runtime and api today — will tag `runtime v0.14.1` and `api v1.9.0` if no objections. Runtime bump will also add the compatibility shim.

emily: Console has a tiny prop rename in the UI — won't block the bump but need a quick review. If we want to hold UI until after the release, I can mark it `post-release`.

frank: From infra side, can we run the cross-repo smoke matrix after pins land? @infra-bot can you schedule a job for Wednesday noon PT to run API+Runtime+SDK integration smoke tests?

infra-bot: scheduled: crossrepo-smoke v1 -> Wed 2026-03-25 12:00 PT. Notifications to #eng-releases + owners.

ben: For clarity — PR checklist for this cut:
- bump version in repo root (package/version files)
- add changelog entry under `unreleased/` with one-line summary
- tag PR with `release-candidate` label
- assign at least one reviewer from each impacted area (api/runtime/console/sdk)

carla: Adding changelog template here to save time:

```
- (component) Bump to vX.Y.Z — short note about change and migration notes (if any)
```

devon: Example git flow I used: 
```
git checkout -b release/runtime-0.14.1
# update version and changelog
git commit -am "runtime: bump v0.14.1 — kv cache fix"
git push origin release/runtime-0.14.1
# open PR targeting release-0.14
```

emily: Pinged @carla and @ben for console review once I open the PR. Will set milestone `v0.14`.

frank: Also: please label changelog PRs with `release-notes` so Docs can pull them. Docs will compile the final release notes on Tue evening.

alice: Small coordination note — if any repo needs a minor schema tweak that affects compatibility, ping me immediately. We can coordinate a canary route for a few hours to verify.

ben: Who's owning the final merge window on Wed morning? I can be on call 9–11am PT to resolve merge conflicts.

carla: I'll handle SDK bumps (python + node). Will open PRs and add migration notes.

devon: Runtime/Api PRs opened (WIP). Tagging reviewers: @carla @ben @emily.

emily: Console PR opened and linked to changelog entry. 

frank: infra will run pre-merge CI matrix today against the release branches. If anything fails, I'll ping in this thread.

ben: LGTM on the plan. Reminder to everyone: set PR titles like `release: bump <component> to vX.Y.Z` so our automation picks them up.

alice: Thanks all — final reminder: cutoff Tue 18:00 PT, release day Wed 10:00 PT. If you need extra handoff, drop notes in the PR or ping here. :thumbsup:
